name: comp-24

frames.best_why: The field is filled with text and the clear icon sits at the right, with no cursor covering either.

tagline: A text box with a circled cross inside it that wipes the line clean.
summary: A labelled text field whose right edge holds a small circled-x while it has content. Clicking the cross empties the field, brings back the placeholder and returns the cursor.
appearance: A small label sits above a rounded dark field on a black stage. While it holds text a faint circled-x sits inside the right edge; when empty, that icon disappears and a grey Type something... placeholder runs from the left.
behaviour: Typing fills the field and makes the circled-x appear; clicking it empties the field, restores the placeholder and moves the caret back into the box. The clip hovers the icon, clears to empty, then types Quarterly roadmap.
demo_content: Label Input with clear button, starting value Click to clear, later typed Quarterly roadmap.
search_phrases: text box with an x to erase
erase button inside a form field
wipe the line and start again
small cross inside a text field
use_when: A single-line field where users often want to start over, such as quick search or a short note.
avoid_when: Clearing is instant with no undo, so a stray click on the cross loses the whole entry.
customise: The label, starting value and placeholder are set in the file; the field and clear-button styling are classes there too.
weight_why: One field and one conditional icon button; no animation at rest.

a11y.note: The clear control is a labelled button and the field has a bound label, but nothing announces that the text was wiped.

polish_why: Clean field with a clear affordance, but otherwise a very ordinary text box.
title: Clearable Text Input
